blocks.text: Pollution par qaboo in tareeqon (strategies) se kiya ja sakta hai:

items: Industries aur municipalities (baladiyat) ke liye ganda pani chhorne (discharge) ke sakht mayaar (standards) lagu karna, taake nuqsan-deh pollutants pani mein na jayein.

Sewage treatment plants (STPs) ko behtar aur bara karna, Effluent Treatment Plants (ETPs, yani factory ka ganda pani saaf karne ke plants) lagana, aur nayi technology apnana, jaise membrane filtration aur bioreactors.
Pani ki quality ki musalsal nigrani (monitoring), jis se pollutants ka jaldi pata chalta hai aur gandagi ke waqiat par waqt par action liya ja sakta hai.

Pollution phailane walon par sakht jurmane (penalties) aur saaf tareeqe apnane walon ko inaam (incentives). Is se qanoon torne walon ki hosla-shikni hoti hai aur industries aur logon ko pollution ke baghair, der-pa (sustainable) kaam karne ka shauq milta hai.

blocks.prompt: Do tareeqe batayein jin se hukoomat pani ki pollution par qaboo pa sakti hai.
blocks.explanation: In mein se koi do: discharge ke sakht mayaar; STPs aur ETPs lagana aur behtar karna; pani ki quality ki musalsal nigrani; pollution walon par jurmane aur saaf tareeqon par inaam.

items: Discharge ke mayaar; STPs aur ETPs; musalsal nigrani; jurmane aur inaam.
